DataHive AI — Demo: Arabic Multi-Dialect Emotional Speech
	

A DataHive AI dataset: a stratified 1-hour demo sample from a full corpus of 50+ hours. We can also create larger audio datasets upon client request.
Most public Arabic speech corpora flatten dialect into a single label and ignore emotion entirely. This corpus does the opposite: every recording is tagged with one of four regional Arabic dialects (Najdi, Hejazi, Jordanian, Moroccan) and one of four target emotions (Sad… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/datahiveai/arabic-multidialect-emotional-speech-demo.
